description: Read-only XRPL `server_info` lookup for node health, server state, and validated-ledger status. Use this before interpreting ledger-dependent results when node health or freshness matters; the result provides the node/server status and validated-ledger information needed to assess whether subsequent ledger reads are current and usable. Use n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger for ledger metadata or n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger_data for raw ledger-state entries; this tool requires no parameters and does not modify the ledger.
name: n9t2_xrpl_get_server_info
